_meta.note: Per-modality capability catalogue shown in the Data Sources 'Details' modal. Keyed by a source's `modality`. Purely presentational — extend freely. Questions are illustrative of what OntoSage can answer once the source is connected + its sensors are registered in GraphDB.
_meta.unit_note: These are demonstrated capabilities of the capability ENVELOPE — some need the source enabled AND real/synthetic data loaded + sensors registered (ref:storedAt).

occupancy.title: Occupancy Sensing
occupancy.summary: Presence, headcount and utilisation per space over time. Turns 'is anyone there?' and 'how busy is it?' into data — unlocking desk/room finding, right-sizing space, demand-driven HVAC/cleaning, and safety headcounts.

capabilities: Find a free desk / quiet room right now, filtered by area or floor
See which study spaces, labs or meeting rooms are currently busy vs empty
Discover the least-crowded times of day for a given space
Check whether a bookable space is actually occupied (ghost-booking detection)
Get suggested alternatives when a preferred space is full
questions: Where can I find a free desk on floor 5 right now?
Which study rooms are empty at the moment?
Is the library quiet zone busy right now?
What is the quietest time to use the 3rd-floor labs?
Are there any free meeting rooms near reception?
Is room 5.28 actually occupied or just booked?
Where is the least crowded space to work this afternoon?

capabilities: Measure real utilisation (%) per space, floor and building over any period
Identify chronically under-used or over-subscribed spaces
Quantify peak occupancy and peak times to size services
Compare booked vs actual occupancy to reclaim wasted bookings
Rank spaces by footfall to prioritise maintenance and refurbishment
questions: What was the average utilisation of the 4th floor last month?
Which rooms were used less than 20% of the time last term?
When does the building hit peak occupancy on weekdays?
How many desks are effectively unused across the building?
Which spaces are consistently over capacity at lunchtime?
What is the gap between booked hours and actual occupied hours for meeting rooms?

capabilities: Right-size the estate: evidence for consolidating or releasing floors
Model desk-sharing ratios from real attendance patterns
Understand day-of-week and hybrid-working attendance profiles
Support neighbourhood / activity-based-working design decisions
questions: What is the typical Monday vs Thursday attendance across the building?
What desk-sharing ratio would our real occupancy support?
Which floors could we consolidate without hitting capacity limits?
How has attendance trended over the last three months?

capabilities: Drive demand-controlled ventilation, lighting and heating from real presence
Find spaces conditioned while empty (energy waste)
Correlate occupancy with energy use to target no-regret savings
Report energy intensity per occupied hour (not just per m²)
questions: Which zones are heated or cooled while unoccupied?
How much of our HVAC runtime happens in empty spaces?
What is the energy use per occupied hour on floor 3?
Where would occupancy-based setback save the most?

capabilities: Switch to demand-based cleaning: clean the spaces actually used
Prioritise high-footfall toilets, kitchens and touchpoints
Cut cleaning of untouched rooms to redirect effort
questions: Which washrooms had the highest footfall today?
Which meeting rooms were unused and can skip cleaning?
Where should we focus cleaning during exam week?

capabilities: Live headcount per zone for evacuation and muster reconciliation
Detect out-of-hours presence in normally empty areas
Monitor crowding against capacity limits for safety compliance
Support lone-worker awareness in low-occupancy zones
questions: How many people are currently on floor 2?
Is anyone in the west wing after 22:00?
Are any spaces exceeding their safe capacity right now?
Which zones had unexpected weekend occupancy?

capabilities: Cost-per-occupied-seat and cost-per-utilised-m² metrics
Business case for lease renewal / disposal from utilisation evidence
Chargeback of space to departments by actual usage
questions: What is our cost per occupied seat this quarter?
Which department's allocated space is most under-used?
Does utilisation justify renewing the annex lease?

capabilities: Extract occupancy time-series for pattern-of-life modelling
Study behavioural response to interventions (nudges, layout changes)
Build occupancy-forecasting features for downstream models
questions: Show me the hourly occupancy profile of the atrium for the last 30 days
How did occupancy change after the desk-booking system launched?
Forecast occupancy for the reading room next week

energy.title: Energy Metering
energy.summary: Electrical (and by extension thermal) consumption per meter, floor and building over time — unlocking peak-demand management, cost attribution, waste-hunting, carbon reporting and demand-response.

capabilities: Track kWh and kW demand by meter, floor and whole-building
Identify peak-demand periods and the loads driving them
Find baseload / overnight consumption that should be near-zero
Benchmark floors and buildings against each other and against targets
Spot consumption spikes and drifts that indicate faults or misuse
questions: When did we hit peak electrical demand last month and what drove it?
What is our overnight baseload and is it higher than it should be?
Which floor uses the most energy per m²?
Show me the daily energy profile of floor 5 for the last two weeks
Has any meter shown an unexplained step-change in consumption?
What are our peak hours of usage on weekdays?

capabilities: Estimate and attribute energy cost by area and time-of-use tariff
Model savings from load-shifting away from peak-price windows
Departmental energy chargeback from sub-metering
Forecast monthly spend from consumption trends
questions: What did energy cost us on floor 3 last month?
How much could we save by shifting load off the evening peak tariff?
Which department is the most energy-expensive per head?
What is our projected energy bill for next quarter?

capabilities: Convert consumption to Scope-2 CO2 using grid factors
Report energy intensity (kWh/m², kWh per occupied hour)
Track progress against net-zero / reduction targets
Evidence for BREEAM / LEED / SECR / ESOS reporting
questions: What were our Scope-2 carbon emissions last month?
How does our energy intensity compare to last year?
Are we on track for our 2030 reduction target?
What is the carbon footprint of floor 4?

capabilities: Detect equipment left running out of hours
Flag abnormal consumption that signals a failing asset
Verify that scheduling / setback strategies actually reduce load
Correlate energy with occupancy and weather to explain variance
questions: Is any major plant running outside occupied hours?
Which meter's consumption pattern looks abnormal this week?
Did the new HVAC schedule actually cut consumption?
How much of last week's energy variance is explained by weather?

capabilities: Public energy dashboards to raise awareness
Compare 'my floor' against building averages
Behaviour-change nudges tied to real consumption
questions: How does my floor's energy use compare to the rest of the building?
When is the building greenest to run high-energy tasks?
Did our switch-off campaign reduce evening energy use?

capabilities: Quantify shiftable / curtailable load for demand-response events
Measure response and rebound during a curtailment window
Support participation in flexibility markets
questions: How much load could we curtail for one hour at 5pm?
What was our demand reduction during the last DR event?
Which loads rebounded after the curtailment ended?

Choose a space by acoustic profile (silent / low-chatter / collaborative)

capabilities: Map acoustic hotspots to inform zoning (quiet vs collaboration)
Validate that quiet zones actually stay quiet
Evidence for acoustic interventions (baffles, partitions, carpet)
Balance open-plan noise against focus-work needs
questions: Which areas breach our quiet-zone target most often?
Do our designated quiet zones actually stay below target?
Where would acoustic treatment have the biggest impact?

capabilities: Monitor exposure against comfort / wellbeing thresholds

capabilities: Detect disturbance events (events, works, equipment) by time and place
Provide objective evidence for noise complaints
Assess impact of nearby construction or plant

capabilities: Study acoustic pattern-of-life and its drivers

iaq.title: Indoor Air Quality
iaq.summary: CO2, particulates and related indices per space — unlocking ventilation assessment, health & wellbeing monitoring, stuffiness/comfort answers, and compliance evidence. (Note: the base ontology already carries rich air-quality sensors for bldg1.)

capabilities: Answer 'is this room stuffy / is the air fresh?' objectively
Flag spaces with poor ventilation before they affect concentration
Guide occupants to well-ventilated spaces
Support infection-risk awareness via CO2 as a ventilation proxy
questions: Is meeting room 5.28 stuffy right now?
Which spaces have the freshest air on floor 3?
Where is CO2 highest in the building at the moment?
Is the air quality in the lecture theatre acceptable during classes?

capabilities: Assess whether ventilation matches occupancy (under/over-ventilation)
Drive demand-controlled ventilation from CO2
Detect ventilation faults (rising CO2 despite AHU running)
Balance fresh-air delivery against energy use
questions: Which zones are under-ventilated at peak occupancy?
Is any AHU failing to keep CO2 within target?
Where are we over-ventilating and wasting energy?
How quickly does CO2 recover after a room empties?

capabilities: Evidence against WELL / RESET / CIBSE air-quality guidance
Track exceedance frequency and duration for reporting
Support healthy-building certifications
questions: How often did CO2 exceed 1000 ppm in teaching spaces last term?
Are we compliant with our indoor air quality policy?
Which spaces would fail a WELL air-quality check?

capabilities: Relate IAQ to occupancy, ventilation and outdoor conditions
Model CO2 decay to estimate air-change rates
Study links between air quality and complaints or performance
questions: Estimate the air-change rate of room 4.10 from CO2 decay
How does CO2 track occupancy in the seminar rooms?
Do stuffiness complaints align with measured CO2?
